fieldValues.claim: The same records serve people and agents, each through a surface built for them.
fieldValues.title: One source, two readers
fieldValues.explanation: Facts live once, as records, and a Composition projects them for each reader. People read a projection designed for people. Agents read the records as data, through tools or as files, with no scraping. Neither surface is a degraded copy of the other, because neither is the source.
